CORRECTION, recorded rather than re-rendered: the source-domain delta does NOT translate 1:1 to the output, because render.py extracts at 24fps (-r 24, line 273) and each segment quantizes to that frame grid. Rendered duration went 51.541 -> 49.931, i.e. the real output shift is 1.610s, so the strictly-correct values would be 43.790 and 46.49 — both 70ms later than shipped. Verified on frames rather than assumed: the payoff overlay sits correctly inside its beat either way, and at 46.42 the hero is mid-reveal ('A BUCKET') vs fully landed at 46.49, so the shipped ding actually matches the series' 'hit anticipates the pop' convention better. Left as-is; 70ms did not justify a full re-render. Lesson: any source-domain edit must be re-derived against the 24fps output grid, not carried across arithmetically.
